description: 25 back-to-back trials pairing a resolveExecutionData() call with an inspectArtifact() call against the same unchanged source root and artifact id, each measured with process.hrtime.bigint(); records whether every inspect trial stayed within 2x of that trial's resolve runtime (floored to avoid sub-ms timer noise).
measurableTarget: within 2x of resolve's measured runtime baseline for the same source size, on every trial
